name: Greek Beef Sauté with Bell Pepper, Zucchini, Tomato, Yogurt & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg lean ground beef
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
6 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserve remaining parsley for serving).
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl.

Return pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, parsley, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and softened, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Place in the reserved bowl.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
When the veggies are done, add beef, tomatoes, and olives to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide beef and veggies between plates or bowls. Top with feta, yogurt, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
